findings.title: Threat feed match on a payment login portal
findings.impact: The domain is linked to bank impersonation and credential theft activity.
findings.recommendation: Takedown the domain and notify downstream payment operators immediately.
findings.limitations: The feed signal may be delayed or incomplete; verify with the live feed before blocking all transactions.

findings.title: Brand impersonation on a payment portal
findings.impact: Customers may enter credentials into a phishing portal that appears to belong to the real bank.
findings.recommendation: Add the domain to blocklists and escalate to abuse teams for takedown.
findings.limitations: Some marketing domains reuse brand names; confirm the site content before issuing a full takedown.

checks.detail: Threat feed returned a confirmed indicator match for the payment domain.

precautions: Do not enter account credentials or payment details.
limitations: This is a confirmed threat feed match and should be treated as active abuse.
